statement: Every company must have at least one director who is ordinarily resident in Singapore — a Singapore citizen, a permanent resident, or a pass holder meeting ACRA's local-residency rules — and at least one locally resident director must be appointed at registration; directors must be at least 18 years old, mentally fit, and not disqualified or banned.
caveat: The statutory source is Companies Act 1967 section 145. Foreign pass holders (such as EP holders) should confirm with their pass issuer before taking a directorship, and nominee directors must disclose their nominator to the company at incorporation.
